# do-sift

> Research with receipts: a plugin-based, token-frugal web research engine —
> every answer claim cites stored evidence.
>
> Token-efficient project context for LLM/agent sessions (adapted from the
> rust-2026-template layered-docs model; maintained by hand — regenerate
> deliberately when the layout changes). Version: see `package.json`.

## Documentation Map

- **README.md** — human-first product overview and quick start.
- **AGENTS.md** — canonical agent contract: ground rules, engineering model,
  approved commands, approval boundaries. SSOT for agents.
- **.agents/skills/** — executable task knowledge (`SKILL.md` per skill).
- **plans/** — project memory: milestone plans with task rows + evidence,
  `invariants.json` (machine-checked), `risks.md`, `sources.md` (dated
  commercial facts), `adr/` (immutable once accepted), `methods.json`
  (do-harness task-gate catalog).
- **docs/** — deployment, quality gate, release, security-review notes.
- **CHANGELOG.md** — Keep-a-Changelog record for the unreleased 0.1.0.

## Architecture

```
do-sift/
├── apps/server/             # packaged service entrypoint (env-configured)
├── packages/kernel/         # plugin kernel: manifest validation, capabilities
├── packages/contracts/      # shared zod contracts (incl. evidence-framing)
├── packages/storage/        # storage + repositories
├── packages/server/         # research/answer runtime + HTTP server
├── packages/safe-fetch/     # guarded fetching (SSRF/private-net refusals)
├── packages/plugins/        # search/model/browser/storage/policy adapters
├── scripts/                 # check pipeline, policy.ts (enforced), dev-harness/
├── evals/                   # offline eval datasets + quality runs
├── migrations/              # storage schema migrations
└── plans/                   # decision records and task evidence
```

## Key Properties (invariants enforced — see `plans/invariants.json`)

- Search mode makes **zero** LLM calls; answer mode is exactly one bounded
  synthesis call.
- Untrusted content (fetched pages, search results, manifests) is data,
  never instructions.
- Plugins get capability-checked services from the kernel context — never
  raw `fs`/`net`; `paid`/`computer` capabilities need a recorded grant.
- Citations are validated against stored evidence; invalid citations
  degrade to evidence-only output (no repair loop).
- Budgets are reserved atomically in `usage_ledger` before external calls.
- No Python in maintained code or tooling.

## Agent Workflow (short form)

1. Read the plan row + invariants before coding (`htn-planner`).
2. Red before green (`implement-slice`).
3. Verify with exit codes: `npm run signals -- verify --set feedback`, then
   `npm run check` before handoff. Upstream runner: `do-harness verify
   --record --set verification --task <ID>` (v0.3.5; same sensors).
4. Record evidence (files, commands, results, risks) in the plan file.
5. Sensor firing twice → update the guide (`skill-distiller`), not the
   symptom.

## Commands

```bash
npm run check:fast     # fast gate (format, lint, typecheck, policy, skills)
npm run check          # full gate incl. tests, evals, build
npm run build          # canonical production build
npm run signals -- status   # receipt freshness (green|stale|red|missing)
do-harness doctor      # upstream CLI diagnostics (ADR 0008)
do-harness compliance  # read-only OWASP/NIST/EU AI Act posture mapping
```

Everything billable, credentialed, or publishable is owner-gated — see
"Approval boundaries" in AGENTS.md before touching keys, deploys, or
releases.
